proposition: Ibn Turka's correspondence survives as the Munshaʾāt-i Ṣāʾin-i Turka: 46 letters, fragments or notes by MK's count of the standard collection, 50 with three letters unique to MS Majlis 10196 and one unique to MS Malik 4029; MS Majlis 10196 (copied 828-38/1425-35) carries only 15 of them, in its margins.

mediation.who: Copyists of MSS Majlis 10196, Sinā 316, Dānishgāh 2576, Malik 4029
mediation.where: see MK's manuscript list, pdf p.150-152
mediation.note: Later copies; the compilers' selection and order are not his.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
